axes.brief: The Sisi presidency dominates nominal electoral and parliamentary institutions, with opposition exclusion, military influence and limited effective oversight. Constitutional suffrage and formal removal procedures do not establish competitive accountability in practice. Focused review prioritises implemented competitive renewal and effective oversight; formal powers in controlled institutions are not automatically democratic accountability.
axes.counterEvidence: Formal rules and enforcement are assessed together; union or expert appointment, voter law repeal, recall and unilateral election postponement are separate propositions. The Sisi presidency dominates nominal electoral and parliamentary institutions, with opposition exclusion, military influence and limited effective oversight. Constitutional suffrage and formal removal procedures do not establish competitive accountability in practice. The bank also credits rejection of specific unelected alternatives (experts, unions, military) and narrower formal rights. These literal answers are retained where supported; the resulting percentage is not a probability or validated democracy index. Restrictions on women inform political participation where relevant, without automatically transferring Authority vs Liberty scores.
